id: quran-study/01 Quran Study From Azhar 1 Sura 72;19 28 & Sura 73 By Kathryn Jinns 05 26 1989
title: Quran Study 1 — Sura 72–73 (Catherine, 05/26/1989)

chapters.title: Introduction & Opening Recitation
chapters.description: Catherine Robinson leads a study of Sura 72 (Al-Jinn) and Sura 73 (Al-Muzzammil) that expands beyond verse commentary into a defense of the human messenger and the mathematical proof of the Quran. Includes an extended debate on Sura 72:27's gematrical value of 1919, the nature of the 19 code, and practical guidance on night prayer and meditation.
